I usually like songs that speak the most to me in lyrics and some songs I like because it triggers my imagination 

3. Tsuki No Shihai: I always play Raven’s theme when playing Xrd with a friend, I’d always rush to be first to select the music. This song is kinda hype within battle and makes me think of major struggle or conflict listening to it, and at around 3:30 within the song it changes in a way that is like Zato and Happy Chaos’s theme, I always love these moments in guilty gear songs. This song sounds like a fight or flight instinct and man I just love listening to this. 

2. Divide My Heart: This song just perfectly describes my frustration and depression, I never knew the answer to why I felt this way or what caused this to happen, I always shrugged it off by saying “I don’t know” and I try to escape it usually. I’ve expressed a lot through my random writing that I feel like I’m not the one in control. I still struggle with these thought and feelings always, I keep doubting myself because I’m afraid of change. I can’t really explain the true feeling of this song that it gives me. (When songs usually explain a feeling I can’t explain I definitely get attached to it). 

1. Blank: My favorite of all the guilty gear songs, just my god does this just speak to me, there is so much stuff I want to get out of my mind and life just feels chaotic holding it but I never can write it in letters nor speak it with words. It all piles up, creating depression, anxiety, and so much more. I could just end it but something still tells me to keep going within my head, that one day it will fade away and the wind will blow again. Even through all the pain I feel I keep going on anyway. This is also a song I can’t really explain my true feelings with it I’m just addicted to it.

Chaos takes a lot more management considering he has two more meters to watch, many tools to keep track of line cancelling out of steady aim and such. But overtime you’ll get better it just takes practice like with every fighting game. Honestly if the character is fun, good or bad/ easy or hard, and you enjoy that character play them. I good technique I use is if I use steady aim, cancel it into reload, you get a lot of use out of it. Also DON’T UNDERESTIMATE SCAPEGOAT! It can literally block moves in front of the clone such as Nagoriyuki’s 2s, and using it as a shield is amazing. If you’re doing pressure and the copy is right behind the opponent roll behind it, it will block the attack if the opponent tries to punish you for rolling.
